Solar for Commercial & Industrial


# **How Solar Works?**

Photovoltaic (PV) modules are used in solar power systems to convert sunlight into electrical energy. The generated electricity can be stored or immediately utilised. The extra energy can be pooled with one or more generators or renewable energy sources or pumped back into the grid.

Your electricity cost is decreased via Net Energy Metering (NEM), which matches your input and production of Solar Energy In Malaysia.

#### **Why Commercial & Industries Choose Solar Energy?**

- **Reduced Energy Bill Costs-** The potential for significant cost savings on energy costs is one of the main benefits of installing solar PV for commercial and industries. Businesses can reduce their dependency on the grid and save their monthly energy costs by installing on-site electricity generation.
- **Environmental Stewardship and Corporate Social Responsibility –** Adopting solar PV displays a commitment to corporate social responsibility and environmental sustainability. Businesses may dramatically lower their greenhouse gas emissions and contribute to a more sustainable future by utilizing Solar Energy In Malaysia.
- **Energy Independence and Reliability-** Businesses benefit from energy reliability and independence because of solar PV installations. Companies that generate their own electricity are less vulnerable to changes in utility costs and power disruptions, assuring uninterrupted operations and reducing downtime.
- **Positive customer perception and brand image –** Solar PV investment improves a company’s image and customer perception. Customers value and support companies that put sustainability and environmentally friendly practices first. Businesses can set themselves apart as leaders in their sector who are environmentally responsible by switching to solar power.

#### **PENSOLAR is a Registered Solar Photovoltaic Investor (RPVI) in providing the option of financing the entire project.**

## Investment

Readily available capital to minimize or eliminate customer capital expenditure (CAPEX) spending

## Solar Power Purchase Agreement (PPA)

Pensolar offers one of the best rates for solar leasing mechanisms. We as the RPVI will be responsible for installation, operation and maintenance while the premise owner purchases the electricity generated at lower competitive rates for an agreed duration.

## Zero-CAPEX Solutions

Pensolar will take on the financial responsibilities of the project thru a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) for the customer to incur Zero-CAPEX

## Authorities & Permits

We handle all applications of permits and licenses required by both state and federal authorities, so the customer doesn’t have to.

What do You need to Install Solar?

![suitable roof size](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/suitable-roof-size.png)

## Suitable Roof Size

A 100 square foot roof will need to generate RM 100 worth of electricity each month. Additionally, a flatter rooftop will make it possible to put more solar panels to generate Solar Electricity.

![Excellent Condition of The Roof](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Excellent-Condition-of-The-Roof.png)

## Excellent Condition of The Roof

Roof leaking is neither caused by nor prevented by solar panels. Please make sure there are no leaks in your roof before installing solar panels.

![Asset 1](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Asset-1.png)

## Constant Electricity Usage

Please be mindful that your Tenaga Nasional Berhad credit will expire after one year for households and one month for companies if your electricity consumption falls below the cutoff for the proposed plan.

![Patience](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Patience.png)

## Patience

The long-term investment in a solar power system will pay off. Only if you are patient will you be able to enjoy the rewards.

Our Process of Solar Installation

## Comprehensive Energy Assessment

Your commercial property receives a comprehensive energy assessment from our professionals. We examine your facility’s Solar Electricity potential, assess your energy usage habits, and choose the best size and layout for the solar PV system.

## Design and Engineering

Our team creates a tailored solar PV system to fit your requirements based on the energy evaluation. To maximise the system’s effectiveness and efficiency, our Solar Energy Companies consider variables including the amount of available space, the need for energy, and operational limitations.

## Permit and Compliance

We manage the required permissions and make sure all laws and building codes are followed. You can focus on your main business operations while our team handles the paperwork and communicates with the appropriate authorities.

## Installation and Commissioning

Our Solar Energy Companies experts complete the installation process carefully and quickly. They set up the mounting systems, inverters, and solar panels, making sure all the electrical connections are made correctly and the system is integrated. We carry out extensive testing and commissioning after the installation is finished to ensure the system’s functionality and security
